faq.getting_started_a: Start by filling out your profile — the more information you add, the better your CV and application will be. Then paste a FINN.no link on the home screen and tap 'Analyze job'. On Android, you can also share a job ad directly from the FINN.no app, your browser, or other apps via the 'Share' menu and select ReadyCV — the link is then filled in automatically on the job analysis screen.
faq.generate_cv_q: How do I generate a CV and cover letter?
faq.generate_cv_a: Analyze a job first, open the analysis and tap 'Generate CV and cover letter'. You'll then see a template picker with 5 different CV templates to choose from — tap any template to preview it in full size. Pick a template, or let AI recommend the best one for this specific job.
faq.templates_a: You can choose between 5 templates: Creative (two-column with a colored sidebar), Professional (clean, tidy single column), Classic (traditional serif style), Modern (orange accent, bold typography), and Scandinavian (minimalist with lots of whitespace). You can also choose 'Recommended' — then AI picks the best template based on the job you're applying for.
faq.pdf_vs_email_q: What's the difference between PDF and email?
faq.pdf_vs_email_a: Tapping 'Generate PDF' gives you a PDF containing both the cover letter and CV combined in one document — handy for digital submission. After the CV is generated, you can also tap 'Send application' to get that exact same application and CV sent to you as separate files by email.
faq.cv_language_q: Can I get the CV in English?
faq.cv_language_a: Yes — the language is now chosen automatically based on the language the job ad is written in (Norwegian or English). If you want it in the other language instead, tap 'Change language' on the analysis screen. The cover letter follows the same language.
faq.match_score_a: The match score shows how well your profile matches the requirements in the job ad. Below 40% is a weak match, 40–70% is a good match, and above 70% is a strong match.
faq.interview_practice_a: Open a job analysis and tap 'Interview practice' there — the interview is tailored to the exact position you analyzed. You get one question at a time and can answer by typing, or by speaking after tapping the microphone button.
faq.what_is_stored_q: What is stored in the app?
faq.what_is_stored_a: Your profile, CV documents, job analyses and applications are stored securely and remain available until you delete your account. See the privacy policy for details.
faq.add_experience_q: How do I add experience and education?
faq.add_experience_a: Go to Profile and tap the 'Experience' or 'Education' card to expand it. Tap '+ Add' to register a new entry.
faq.upload_existing_cv_q: Can I upload a CV I already have instead of typing everything in myself?
faq.upload_existing_cv_a: Yes — tap 'Import CV' on the home screen or under Profile, then choose a file, take a photo or pick one from your gallery. We read the CV automatically and fill in your profile with the information we find.
faq.supported_file_formats_q: Which file formats are supported when I upload a CV?
faq.supported_file_formats_a: PDF and Word (.docx) as a file, or an image (photo/gallery) of the CV. The old Word format (.doc) is not supported — save it as PDF or .docx first.
faq.after_cv_upload_q: What happens after I upload my CV?
faq.after_cv_upload_a: We read the content and show you a preview of what we found (name, experience, education, skills, etc.). Nothing is saved to your profile until you confirm the preview.
